claims.explanation: GSK1070916 is a potent Aurora B/C inhibitor; sensitivity is driven by high expression of the drug targets AURKB/AURKC and a strong mitotic/proliferation program. The virtual cell confirms this by showing downregulation of BIRC5, PLK1, TOP2A, CDK1, CCNA2, KIF20A and NUSAP1. MYC expression and FBXW7/PIK3CA mutations may further sensitize by promoting this mitotic state.
